basic_details.short_information: Assam Skill University (ASU) has announced 1 vacancy for the post of Guest Faculty on a temporary basis for a duration of four months. Eligible candidates can attend a walk-in interview on 13 November 2026. Applicants must possess a Master's Degree in relevant disciplines with 55% marks, and PhD or NET, or an M.E/M.Tech/M.S./Integrated M.Tech./M.Sc./Integrated M.Sc./M.Voc in Food Technology/Food Processing/Food Engineering/Dairy Technology/Chemical Engineering/Post-harvest Engineering/Food Science & Nutrition. how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ASU Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview.
Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification.

Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable).
Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification.
Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview.
Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities.
Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. When is the ASU Guest Faculty walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Assam Skill University will hold the Guest Faculty walk-in interviews on 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. Which department is the ASU Guest Faculty walk-in for?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is for Guest Faculty in the Dept. of Food Technology of Assam Skill University, Mangaldai.

faq.question: Q3. Is the ASU Guest Faculty engagement permanent?
faq.answer: No, the notice says the engagement as Guest Faculty is on a temporary basis.

faq.question: Q4. Where can I check the ASU Guest Faculty eligibility and remuneration?
faq.answer: ASU directs candidates to the Recruitment section of https://asu.ac.in for the eligibility criteria, educational qualifications, remuneration and other important instructions.

faq.question: Q5. Where is the ASU Guest Faculty interview schedule given?
faq.answer: The interview schedule is published in the Recruitment section of the official ASU website, https://asu.ac.in.

faq.question: Q6. What is the advertisement number of the ASU Guest Faculty recruitment notice?
faq.answer: The notice number is ASU/GUEST FACULTY/2026/209/240, dated 03-11-2026, issued by the Registrar of Assam Skill University.
